videos.title: "What's the use of giving 600 million won in treasury shares?" Why do people feel disillusioned e...
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. Samsung Electronics semiconductor employees may receive a maximum of 6 billion won in special bonuses, causing concern about actual losses. Calculations show that around 2.5 billion won could be lost.
2. If a DS division employee at Samsung Electronics with a salary of 1 billion won receives an additional 6 billion won in special bonuses, total wages would reach approximately 7 billion won. With the highest tax bracket, a 42% tax rate is applied, resulting in around 2.47 billion won in income tax. Adding local income tax could increase tax burden further.
3. Without the bonus, the tax liability would be around 1.27 billion won. However, with the addition of the 6 billion won bonus, the tax amount increases nearly 19 times, leaving a net take-home pay of approximately 4.5 billion won, which is about half of the pre-tax bonus. The bonus is given in the form of Samsung Electronics shares, but this does not mean lower taxes; the company first collects taxes and then distributes the remaining amount as shares. Tax is calculated based on the stock price without selling the shares. Samsung Electronics employees are discussing a special management bonus scheme that could potentially award up to 6 billion won in performance bonuses to semiconductor memory business division employees. The union has postponed a planned strike for now.

videos.title: 삼성전자 노사 합의안 투표 이틀째...투표율 74%↑ / YTN
